structured.approach:
The refusal named three unsupported statements about earlier attempts: their history, a verifier run, and a citation-resolution question. I removed all of them from task.code.md: the revision note, the verifier sentence in section 5, and open question CQ-4. The rewritten file makes no statements about earlier attempts. Every source it cites is a contracted input, tool:repo, record:brief or record:memory. Facts about package.json and the CI bar are cited to task.components.

I re-ran `node ci.mjs` and git status/diff --stat to confirm the working tree before rewriting. The code and docs in ap_portal are as shown in the tool view: renderOverdueRisk with its private helpers, VERSION 2.4.0, README.md and docs/ap_portal.md.
tools_used: Bash (node ci.mjs, git status, git diff --stat)

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk is added to src/ap_portal/index.js and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary. Those existing exports are unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or [] and throws TypeError for any other non-array. Otherwise it returns <table class="overdue-risk">, a plain header row (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount), and one <tr class="risk-…"> per row in the given order.

The amount is handled only as a string matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$ and padded to two decimals as text. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never called on it, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '). The row class is restricted to the four risk values; any other value renders risk-unknown.

VERSION in index.js moved from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0. task.components records 2.3.0 as the version in both index.js and package.json. package.json is outside this step's write scope, so it is not changed here.

The ap_portal CI bar is compile, unit tests, line coverage of at least 90%, and static checks (no console.log or eval(, lines at most 140 characters). The new code keeps the static checks clean but has no tests yet, so the coverage bar is not met in this step.
This step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so the new unit tests in tests/portal.test.js are not added here.

The brief requires README.md and docs/ to document the module overview and the new functions with signatures, inputs, outputs and examples. This step updated README.md and added docs/ap_portal.md for renderOverdueRisk.
Existing public signatures are kept, and the new behaviour is a new function.

open_questions: CQ-1: CI fails only on line coverage, which is below the 90% bar, until the feat.design B4.5 tests are added. tests/ is outside FE-04's write scope. Is a coverage-only CI failure acceptable for FE-04's automated check?
CQ-2: package.json "version" stays 2.3.0 while VERSION is now 2.4.0. package.json is outside FE-04's write scope, so a later step needs to set it to 2.4.0.
CQ-3: Confirm 2.4.0 as the minor version step (carried from task.components CQ-FE-2).
Carried unchanged: TQ-6, TQ-7, TQ-11, OQ-B8, OQ-B9, OQ-B10, DQ-3, PQ-P7, CQ-FE-1 (styles for the risk-* classes).
